A28-3-intro.quote: the subject matter, duration, nature and purpose of the processing, the types of Client Data and the categories of individuals concerned

A28-3-a.quote: The Supplier will not process Client Data for any purpose other than on the Client's documented instructions

A28-3-b.quote: No member of the Supplier's staff may access Client Data unless that person is bound by a duty of confidentiality

A28-3-c.quote: appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect Client Data

A28-2.quote: The Client gives the Supplier a general written authorisation to use subcontracted processors

A28-3-d.quote: engage a subcontracted processor only under the conditions set out in this Part III

A28-3-e.quote: help the Client to respond to requests from individuals who exercise their rights under Chapter III GDPR

A28-3-g.quote: the Supplier will, at the Client's choice, delete or return all Client Data

A28-3-h.quote: make available to the Client all information necessary to demonstrate that it meets the obligations in Article 28 GDPR

defects.description: No assistance with security, breach notification, impact assessments or prior consultation (Articles 32 to 36).
No flow-down of the same obligations to subcontracted processors and no liability for them.
No duty to tell the Client when an instruction appears to infringe the law.
